rows.text: walks the circular list headed at `rcx+8` (next link at node qword `+0`) and for each node calls `00222170(qword node+0x10, edx)`; returns `al` = 1 at the first non-zero result, else 0 once the walk returns to the head
calls `007A7010(rcx+0x38)` with the other incoming registers and, only when it returns non-zero, calls `007A81F0(rcx+0x38, (float)r8d / 127.0, 0.0, -1)`

when `edx` is non-zero calls `00221ED0` with the incoming registers and, when that returns an object for which `00225680(object)` is non-zero, calls `002257E0(object, r9d, 0)` and returns `al` = 1; when `edx` is 0 and dword `+0x38` of `rcx` equals `r8d` it calls `002224F0(rcx, r9d, 0)` and returns 1; every other path returns 0

when `edx` is non-zero calls `00221ED0` with the incoming registers and, when that returns an object for which `00225680(object)` is non-zero, calls `007A84A0(object+8, (float)r9d / 60.0, -1)` and returns `al` = 1; when `edx` is 0 and dword `+0x38` of `rcx` equals `r8d` it calls `002225B0(rcx, r9d)` and returns 1; every other path returns 0

when `edx` is non-zero calls `00221ED0` with the incoming registers and, when that returns an object for which `00225680(object)` is non-zero, calls `002257E0(object, the fifth (stack) argument, r9d)` and returns `al` = 1; when `edx` is 0 and dword `+0x38` of `rcx` equals `r8d` it calls `002224F0(rcx, the fifth argument, r9d)` and returns 1; every other path returns 0
